name: Lake Shooter
author: Jimmy Cartrette
description: A River Raid-style shooter: fly up the river, shoot the boats and helicopters and keep an eye on your fuel gauge.

descriptions.en: A River Raid-style shooter: fly up the river, shoot the boats and helicopters and keep an eye on your fuel gauge.
descriptions.it: Uno sparatutto in stile River Raid: risali il fiume in volo, abbatti navi ed elicotteri e tieni d'occhio l'indicatore del carburante.
